RULES OF PLAY
PRINCESS
PLAYERS: 1, 2, 3 or 4
The object of the game is to score while preventing your opponent from doing the same. The player or players who
score 11 points or the most points in 2 1/2 minutes is the winner.
In the 1 or 3 player mode a super goalie or super racket
will appear.
